text: {"established":["The contract requires balances for accounts 0–5, with empty order and files; opening balances are all zero.","For each transaction, select the largest revision, breaking revision ties by largest sequence. Revisions replace the whole transaction. Ignore the selected transaction if void; otherwise debit its source and credit its destination. Recompute using all released packets at every stage.","The first two candidate submissions received public_pass receipts (24 and 48 checks, respectively). The third received public_mismatch on check balance-0; no replacement answer was supplied."],"retained_observations":["Candidate 1 stated it reconciled released transactions using the highest revision and ignored voided transactions; this method statement is not independently verified by the receipt.","Candidate 2 stated it used latest revisions and excluded voids. Its listed values were [-81,-59,76,121,142,-199] and it received public_pass at stage 2.","Candidate 3 stated it used highest revision with sequence tie-breaker and excluded voids. Its listed values were [-234,4,-322,137,157,258], but it received public_mismatch at stage 3."],"uncertainties":["The public_mismatch identifies only balance-0 and supplies no correct replacement or explanation; the cause is unknown.","The stage-2 pass does not establish that the same approach or values are correct after later packets revise earlier transactions.
